description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa USPhoneBook. Mtu hufuata hatua kwenye orodha ya ukaguzi; OpenOptOut hutoa anwani ya barua pepe ya mara moja na kubofya kiungo cha uthibitisho.
instructions: Look up your phone number on usphonebook.com. If you're listed, open usphonebook.com/opt-out and follow the steps, using {contact_email} where it asks for an email. If the opt-out page just hangs, email support+optout@usphonebook.com and ask to be removed. Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
